questions.question: When the women of Israel sang that Saul killed thousands and David tens of thousands, how did King Saul react?

answers.text: He was furious and resented it
He joined in and sang along
He was proud of David for it

questions.question: While David played the harp for King Saul, what did Saul do with the spear in his hand?

answers.text: He set it down to listen

questions.question: Why did King Saul become afraid of David?

answers.text: The LORD was with David but had left Saul
Samuel had warned Saul about David
David had threatened to take the throne
